notes: The batch file holds 15 groups, not 10, and all 15 are covered. Verdicts: publish 13, not_a_group 1, out_of_area 1, hide 0. Sites that did not resolve (DNS error with and without www): larazaforliberation.org, thelectionarycompany.org, legendaryperfprmances.org (typo), legendaryperformances.org, lectionarycompany.org, lgbtheart.org, nalsofphiladelphia.org, namcphiladelphia.org. Marathon Acts site returned 404 on both forms. The Mazeppa Productions site on file is an unrelated personal site and was not used. The Military Assistance Project site is a parked page. ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer was used for IRS facts where the group's own site was dead, blocked or parked. Records without audience.open_to (Kiwanis, La Raza, Lectionary, Legendary, Marathon Acts, Mazeppa, Military Assistance, Mobilized, NALS, NAMC) are held back on purpose until checked. LGBT Heart has no source URL (its ProPublica page returned 404), so it is held back too. No WebSearch was left for Legendary Performances, Marathon Acts, Lectionary Company, La Raza, NALS, NAMC or Mobilized. The best next checks: the Kiwanis club number, NALS Philadelphia, Legendary Performances and LGBT Heart. Rate limiting was not seen.

records.name: LGBT Heart
records.summary: A group whose IRS legal name points to LGBT health education and research. I could not reach a website, and my one search for LGBT Heart found no current listing under that name, so its programs and how to take part are not yet known.
records.notes: Both www.lgbtheart.org and lgbtheart.org fail to resolve (DNS error). The ProPublica page for this EIN returned HTTP 404, so there is no public source page to cite and the record has no sources, which holds it back. The legal name is Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender Health Education Research TR Inc, with an alternate name LGBT Heart in the batch. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out. The LGBT search results were general directories and mention William Way and Philly Pride 365 (see leads_only), not this group.
